name: Kelly Morrison
stance: Calls for hearings, investigations and comprehensive AI regulation in response to researchers' warnings of existential risk, and criticizes the executive order blocking state AI guardrails.

statements.text: Criticized President Trump's executive order blocking states from setting their own AI guardrails as selling democracy to tech billionaires.

AI researchers themselves are warning of an existential threat to humanity. Congress can’t wait. Mike Johnson needs to cancel recess so we can get to work immediately – hearings, investigations, and comprehensive regulation.
The threat from AI is serious. We need a president who will take it seriously.
